I will think about this year the way I always do — look at what I did last year, look at what my neighbors are doing, and decide.

My 8 mu — I keep 2 mu for cotton on the piece that drains well, and 6 mu for wheat-maize rotation like most years. Cotton price has not been good these last years but I know how to grow it, so I keep a little.

**Wheat (6 mu, winter)** — I already planted last October. Now in spring I do the green-up watering and topdress. At planting I put one bag of 复合肥 (15-15-15), 50 jin — that is one bag per mu as basal. Now at jointing I spread 尿素, about half a bag per mu, maybe 25 jin. If the wheat looks yellow I add a little more. I water 3 times — green-up, jointing, grain filling. I spray 2 times — once for aphids and powdery mildew together, once for the scab if weather is wet. Last year I got about 450 kg/mu, this year I hope the same.

**Maize (6 mu, summer)** — After wheat harvest in June I plant maize directly, no plowing, just straw chopper and seeder. One bag of 复合肥 at planting as basal, 40 jin. At big flare stage I topdress 尿素 half a bag. Water 2 times if no rain. Spray 1 time for borer. Last year 550 kg/mu.

**Cotton (2 mu, spring)** — I plow this piece, cotton needs loose soil. I use improved seed from the shop, they all sell Bt now. Basal 复合肥 50 jin/mu plus 二铵 20 jin. Topdress urea at flowering. Cotton needs many sprays — bollworm, aphid, spider mite — I spray 6 times, that is just how cotton is. Water 2 times. Hope for 220 kg seed cotton per mu.

I am 68, just me and my wife, so I cannot do too much by hand. I hire the combine for wheat and maize harvest. Fertilizer costs keep going up, but I would rather put enough than harvest poorly — a bad harvest is real loss, extra fertilizer is only some yuan.
